execution_order: Every tested solver/test source revision was pushed before its numerical runs; documentation and stored-data audits followed.

guards.method: AST extracts only the committed comparison/audit functions or assertions; no module import, solver, MPI, or build.

omitted: arterial warmup/timing VTUs (all their logs, CSVs, and correction histories retained)
baseline non-arterial tube VTUs (optional file list retained; logs, CSVs, and metrics included)
historical arterial VTUs duplicated by final full trajectories

limitations: single-host at most four MPI ranks; no multi-node scaling evidence
twolevel is an explicit rank/semantic coarse space, not full coupled AMG or rotational near-nullspace
full fluid subblock must be invertible for added_mass
bounded fluid Krylov response makes the Schur action inexact; outer FGMRES does not make it an exact linear inverse
new RCR recipe comparisons cover generalized-alpha, two ranks, two steps and same-partition restart
new methods reduce outer iterations but are slower on both measured arterial fixtures
